title: Programme portfolio adoption, migration, enforcement and read-only route

CANON.question: Adopt Programme Genesis v0.2 contracts, source precedence, append-only event model, typed dependency semantics, health rules and deterministic portfolio read-model contract as the OVC programme-governance canon?
pass_effect: Programme Genesis v0.2 becomes the authoritative programme-governance framework for new and migrated programme records.
Source precedence, fail-closed authority, append-only corrections, scope-audit rules, typed edges and state-synchronisation invariants become binding.
Derived portfolio views remain subordinate to programme-owned state and accepted decisions.
PASS does not itself adopt migrated programme facts, activate enforcement, register a route or enable upkeep.
CANON.defer_effect: All merged Programme Genesis artifacts remain approved implementation evidence but non-canonical; no later Programme Genesis authority may activate.
CANON.rollback: Supersede the canon non-destructively, disable derived Programme Genesis services and preserve all accepted source records, decisions and events.

MIGRATION.question: Adopt the seven source-linked migration records as accepted provisional portfolio records while retaining permanent MIGRATION_UNCERTAINTY until native Genesis?
pass_effect: Seven exact-path/SHA-bound programme-state imports become accepted provisional portfolio records.
They remain PROVISIONAL_NON_CANONICAL with authority_effect NONE and do not become native Genesis records.
Fourteen migration warnings and seven unresolved-field health warnings remain visible.
No imported edge or value gains authority beyond the underlying programme-owned source.

Active or in-flight migrated programmes receive a visible waiver only until their next authority-changing gate or programme boundary; terminal programmes require native Genesis before reactivation or supersession.
MIGRATION.defer_effect: The seven records remain reproducible migration candidates and may be viewed locally, but they are not adopted into the accepted portfolio inventory.
acceptance_basis: exact source path and SHA-256 re-verification
warnings: The migration census covers only programme-owned state records discoverable under the frozen registry.
It does not claim that every historical OVC programme has a machine-readable programme-state record.
Warnings are accepted as visible provisional limitations, not resolved facts.
MIGRATION.rollback: Withdraw provisional migration adoption without rewriting source state; retain every imported source hash, warning and decision and rebuild later from programme-owned records.

ENFORCEMENT.question: Activate new-programme admission enforcement using the frozen creation test, three-programme negative-fit scope audit and maintenance-authority registry?
pass_effect: New programme proposals outside an accepted maintenance entry must pass the Genesis creation test and three-programme negative-fit scope audit.
Unmatched or ambiguous work becomes NOT_EVALUABLE and requires a Genesis proposal gate.
Enforcement must remain fail-closed and cannot create programmes or grant reserved authority.
ENFORCEMENT.defer_effect: Contracts and registries remain binding guidance, but no automated admission consumer may block or admit repository work.
defer_rationale: The merged baseline contains frozen admission contracts and registries but no separately validated active enforcement consumer.
The accepted migration inventory contains only seven discovered programme-state records and retains fourteen warnings.
Activating enforcement before a complete executable consumer and broader portfolio coverage would create false precision.
minimum_future_pass_evidence: tests for maintenance-match, scope-audit, ambiguity and bypass cases
complete declared inventory or explicit bounded coverage contract
ENFORCEMENT.rollback: Set enforcement_enabled false, preserve every enforcement finding and revert to proposal-only review without rewriting accepted programme records.

READ_ONLY_ROUTE.question: Register and activate the Programme Genesis read-only Control Plane route using the accepted compact report and full read model?
pass_effect: Register the candidate /programmes route as read-only.
Expose programme state, health, uncertainty and dependency summaries without mutation methods.
Keep write, enforcement, agent and upkeep capabilities disabled.
READ_ONLY_ROUTE.defer_effect: The deterministic payload and disabled adapter projection remain locally available, but no route is registered and no listener is activated.
defer_rationale: The merged baseline proves local payload computability and a disabled adapter contract, not an implemented network or Control Plane route.
The adapter registry explicitly has route_registered false and network_listener false.
Setting route_registered true without a validated route implementation would create a non-reproducible authority claim.
minimum_future_pass_evidence: authentication and access-boundary contract where applicable
route schema and full uncertainty visibility tests
proof of no mutation, enforcement or agent-write methods
READ_ONLY_ROUTE.rollback: Unregister and disable the route, retain local deterministic reports and preserve all access and health evidence.

decision_independence: CANON PASS does not imply MIGRATION, ENFORCEMENT or READ_ONLY_ROUTE PASS.
MIGRATION PASS does not convert provisional records into native Genesis or grant authority to imported values.
ENFORCEMENT PASS does not register the read-only route or enable writes.
READ_ONLY_ROUTE PASS does not activate enforcement, mutation or upkeep.
Any DEFER leaves the corresponding capability disabled without blocking independent PASS decisions unless an explicit dependency is stated.

recommended_combined_decision.rationale: The governance model and provisional migration records are reproducible and fail-closed, while active enforcement and route implementations are not yet independently materialised and validated.

exact_recommended_operator_command: OVC APPROVE PG-G6 CANON=PASS MIGRATION=PASS ENFORCEMENT=DEFER READ_ONLY_ROUTE=DEFER
rollback: Apply rollback independently per decision part; preserve every accepted source, migration warning, read-model hash, graph record, gate decision, PR and commit.
work_after_recommended_approval: Record the four-part PG-G6 operator decision and merge the decision packet.
Mark Programme Genesis v0.2 canon adopted and the seven migration records accepted provisional if those parts PASS.
Keep admission enforcement and the Control Plane route disabled if DEFER is selected.
Create PG-WP6 bounded candidate-event upkeep branch only if the accepted PG-G6 parts satisfy its prerequisites.
Build the collector disabled and stop at operator-required PG-G7 before any upkeep activation.
